gm.second_isomer: -131.2496 eV (+0.20 eV), Cs, one 2-fold Al; traps 2/10 BH runs up to 150k steps
gm.literature: DFT (Al2O3)n GMs: compact, Al2O2 + Al3O3 rings, 3-5-fold Al, 2-4-fold O (Rahane, Deshpande & Kumar, JPCC 115, 18111 (2011)); n=4: B3LYP GM 4A is C1, PBE0 prefers a D3d isomer 4B (Gobrecht et al., A&A 658, A167 (2022), which cites IR experiments (Sierka et al. 2007) supporting 4A). NEP89 GM is Cs with the DFT-like ring/coordination features; exact match to 4A not verified (CDS coordinates unreachable from NERSC).

notes: Final budget 69000 = 3 x BH median hit 23056 (BH SR 0.7, RS SR 0.0 at 69000; BH SR 0.8 at 150000). Tight (fmax 0.005) re-relaxation of all 8 GM hits: spread < 0.1 meV -> e_tol 0.02. Two-funnel landscape: the +0.20 eV Cs isomer traps 2/10 BH runs; RS never reaches the GM (best +0.30 eV). Sibling candidate cl_Al6O9 (same pilot) was dropped: its NEP89 GM is a D3h trigonal-prism drum (all Al 3-fold, rings {6: 2, 8: 3}, no Al2O2 rings), unlike the C1 'tea-cosy' DFT GM of (Al2O3)3 (Gobrecht 2022), and it was easier (BH SR 1.0, RS 0.3).
